limitations: Four graph hyperparameter candidates selected on this same previously reused old fold; bootstrap CI does not account for selection, training-seed variance, or noisy-label uncertainty.

J5 exploratory training runtime differed from historical C; this is not a matched-thread training comparison. Fresh C/J5 with OMP4/MKL4/CUBLAS4096:8 and fixed graph k10/lambda0.3 is required before a stable claim.
P3 original head/mid/tail metrics used equal terciles and must not be read as P1 strata; this audit uses full750 training-count ranks 150/225/375, tie class-index ascending.
Natural750 uses uniform P7 target under a natural long-tail query prior; balanced737 is a disclosed closed-set unique-group support subset, not full750 or an independent fold.
The graph predictions are direct pairwise compared to C. Incremental graph gain versus J5 does not itself establish a total gain versus C.
No automatic full-data training or official-test inference permission is created.
